title: get api version returns version and metadata
description: Test GET /api/version endpoint to verify it returns HTTP 200 with a JSON object containing application version and server metadata without exposing any secrets.

title: get unknown browser route redirects to viewer
description: Test GET request to an unknown browser route to verify it returns HTTP 303 redirect to /viewer and that the redirect is correctly followed by the client.

title: post user register with valid data creates account
description: Test POST /api/user/register with valid name, email, username, and password to verify it returns HTTP 200 with registration status and new user object without including plaintext password.

title: post user login local with valid credentials returns token
description: Test POST /api/user/login/local with valid username and password to verify it returns HTTP 200 with user object and local access token.

title: post user refresh with valid access token refreshes session
description: Test POST /api/user/refresh with a valid access_token to verify it returns HTTP 200 with refreshed user object without plaintext password.

title: post mapping space public returns public spaces and buildings
description: Test POST /api/mapping/space/public with an empty JSON object to verify it returns HTTP 200 with JSON containing spaces and buildings arrays, including valid empty results during recovery.

title: post mapping space add with authorization creates space
description: Test POST /api/mapping/space/add with valid mapping-space JSON and valid authorization token to verify it returns HTTP 200 confirming the created mapping space.

title: post mapping space add without authorization returns 401
description: Test POST /api/mapping/space/add without authorization header to verify it returns HTTP 401 indicating missing or invalid authorization.

title: post navigation route with valid request returns route
description: Test POST /api/navigation/route with valid navigation route request JSON to verify it returns HTTP 200 with navigation route JSON for client guidance.

title: post navigation route with invalid request returns 400
description: Test POST /api/navigation/route with invalid navigation request JSON to verify it returns HTTP 400 indicating invalid navigation request.
